name: unbake-proto
description: Decompile baked protobuf descriptors into human-readable working .proto
author: ph0ryn

scripts.prepack: pnpm run precommit && sort-package-json && pnpm run build && clean-pkg-json -r devDependencies -r peerDependencies
scripts.test:proto2: pnpx protoc --descriptor_set_out=test/descriptor.pb --include_imports test/descriptor.proto && pnpm unbake -i test/descriptor.pb
scripts.test:proto3: pnpx protoc --descriptor_set_out=test/comprehensive.pb --include_imports test/comprehensive.proto && pnpm unbake -i test/comprehensive.pb
scripts.test:single: pnpx protoc --descriptor_set_out=test/comprehensive.pb --include_imports test/comprehensive.proto && node --input-type=module -e "import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { fromBinary, toBinary } from '@bufbuild/protobuf'; import { FileDescriptorProtoSchema, FileDescriptorSetSchema } from '@bufbuild/protobuf/wkt'; const set = fromBinary(FileDescriptorSetSchema, readFileSync('test/comprehensive.pb')); const file = set.file.find((file) => file.name === 'test/comprehensive.proto'); if (!file) throw new Error('Missing test/comprehensive.proto'); writeFileSync('test/comprehensive-single.pb', toBinary(FileDescriptorProtoSchema, file));" && pnpm unbake -i test/comprehensive-single.pb --single
